review: 702.119a-1: the base expected omitted the cast trigger that the decisions resolve; added B 17 and A 23 life.
702.119b-1: the decisions left Crabomination's enters trigger (target opponent) unresolved; added the decision targeting B with B's library, graveyard and hand empty so it exiles nothing.

scenarios.title: Emerge reduces the total cost by the sacrificed creature's mana value
decisions: A chooses to cast Abundant Maw for its emerge cost {6}{B}, choosing Grizzly Bears as the creature to sacrifice.
A sacrifices Grizzly Bears and pays the reduced total cost by tapping all five Swamps.
The cast trigger of Abundant Maw targets B; both players pass and the trigger and then Abundant Maw resolve.

variants.label: sacrifice_mv2
variants.expected: Casting Abundant Maw for its emerge cost is legal: the total cost is {6}{B} reduced by 2 (the mana value of Grizzly Bears) to {4}{B}, five mana, paid with the five Swamps. Grizzly Bears is sacrificed and moves to A's graveyard. Abundant Maw ends on the battlefield. The cast trigger resolves first: B loses 3 life (17) and A gains 3 life (23).

variants.label: sacrifice_mv1
variants.delta: A chooses Mons's Goblin Raiders (mana value 1) as the creature to sacrifice instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Casting Abundant Maw by sacrificing Mons's Goblin Raiders is not payable: the total cost is {6}{B} reduced by 1 to {5}{B}, six mana, and A has only five lands. Abundant Maw stays in A's hand, and nothing is sacrificed.

scenarios.title: Emerge from a quality accepts only a permanent of that quality and reduces the cost by its mana value
decisions: A chooses to cast Crabomination for its emerge from artifact cost {5}{B}{B}, choosing Bronze Sable as the artifact to sacrifice.
A sacrifices Bronze Sable and pays the reduced total cost by tapping all five Swamps.
Both players pass; Crabomination resolves and enters the battlefield.
Its enters trigger targets B; both players pass and it resolves. B's library, graveyard and hand are empty, so nothing is exiled and A casts nothing.

variants.label: sacrifice_artifact_mv2
variants.expected: Casting Crabomination for its emerge cost is legal: the total cost is {5}{B}{B} reduced by 2 (the mana value of Bronze Sable) to {3}{B}{B}, five mana, paid with the five Swamps. Bronze Sable is sacrificed and moves to A's graveyard. Crabomination ends on the battlefield. Its enters trigger resolves and exiles nothing.

variants.label: sacrifice_nonartifact
variants.delta: A tries to sacrifice Grizzly Bears (a mana value 2 creature that is not an artifact) instead of Bronze Sable.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is not a legal choice for emerge from artifact, so the emerge cost cannot be paid. Crabomination, costing {4}{B}{B} (six mana) with no emerge, cannot be cast with five lands and stays in A's hand.

variants.label: sacrifice_artifact_mv0
variants.delta: A sacrifices Ornithopter (an artifact with mana value 0) instead of Bronze Sable.
variants.expected: The emerge cost is reduced by 0, so the total cost is {5}{B}{B}, seven mana, and A has only five lands. Crabomination stays in A's hand and nothing is sacrificed.
